sources.snippet: About Qwen3.5-397B-A17B Qwen3.5-397B-A17B is Alibaba Cloud's largest and most capable multimodal foundation model, released February 2026. With 397B total parameters and 17B activated through a Mixture-of-Experts architecture (512 experts), it achieves state-of-the-art scores on MMLU-Pro (87.8%), GPQA Diamond (88.4%), SWE-bench Verified (80.0%), and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (54.0%).
